text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai has arrived. While Oguri Cap 
will not be running due to injury, Super 
Creek, who battled in the Kikuka Sho, is 
present.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This time, she would make a name for 
herself with her running. Yaeno Muteki 
vowed that while burning with "obsession," 
she would achieve perfect control through 
"Harmonious Union of Fire and Water."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And she declares that she will make all 
the spectators turn their eyes toward her.
